blurb:
The #1 Private Limousine Tour of Pearl Harbor & Historic Honolulu.
Kawika Joe’s Limousine Hawaii will Chauffeur you in Comfort and Style, to Pearl Harbor Visitors Center and the "USS Arizona Memorial", where you will Hear and Experience The Complete story of Dec 7, 1941.
After Pearl Harbor, enjoy an incredible look into Historic Honolulu, and see some of the most sought after places and sites from our Hawaiian History and Royal Ancestry. Take an Up close view and learn about the History and Fall of the only Royal Palace in America, "The Iolani Palace" taken by the United States in 1893, and again in 1959, when The United States officially became the 50th state. Then take a photo opportunity at The Statue Of "King Kamehameha" and learn about his incredible Legacy and How he became The First King of Hawaii. Relax in comfort and style, while you enjoy one of the most Engaging VIP Limousine Chauffeured Private Pearl Harbor and Royal Honolulu Tours on the island of Oahu.
